newsitem.title: USA: Virginia nuke may return to service Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Virginia nuke may return to service Wednesday.

text.p: Virginia Power Co's 911 megawatt North Anna nuclear unit 1 could return to service Wednesday after an electrical equipment failure tripped the unit off line, a company spokesman said.
"It is possible the unit will be back as early as late today," spokesman William Byrd said Wednesday.
Virginia Power was investigating the equipment failure, which occurred Tuesday during routine testing, Byrd said.
The unit is located at Mineral, Va.
Separately, Virginia Power's 781 megawatt Surry nuclear unit 2 in Gravel Neck, Va., returned to full service Tuesday evening after reducing power output for repairs, Byrd said.
"It was back at 100 percent as of last night," he said.
The unit was reduced to 30 percent of capacity early Tuesday to replace an electronic relay.
Virginia Power is a subsidiary of Dominion Resources Inc.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
